tweets.text: Bitcoin's Power Law model held for over a decade. On June 25, it didn't. BTC flash-crashed from $61K to $58K and punched through the support band for the first time in the model's history. That's not a dip — it's a structural question.

A research team gave an LLM direct control of a trapped-ion quantum experiment — every hardware command gated by an authorization token. AI agents calibrating quantum crystals. The future is weirder than anyone predicted.

$205B in on-chain Bitcoin volume across Sub-Saharan Africa, up 52% year-over-year — third-fastest growing region on Earth. Trezor Academy's new documentary shows what adoption looks like when it's driven by necessity, not speculation.

Difficulty jumped +7.15% to 133.87T, fully reversing the -10.09% cut from two weeks ago. Miners didn't flinch. Early-epoch hashrate already reading 987 EH/s. The network keeps getting harder to attack and easier to underestimate.
